claim: Spaced repetition engine implements SuperMemo SM-2 algorithm with dynamic Easiness Factor calculation and interval scheduling.
observed_fact: Direct Kotlin implementation: processAnswer() computes EF' = max(1.3, EF + (0.1 - (5-q)*(0.08 + (5-q)*0.02))), schedules intervals I_1=1d, I_2=3d, I_n=I_{n-1}*EF, resets interval on mistakes (q < 3), and computes retention probability R = exp(-t/S).

claim: Daily streak engine tracks micro-habits, consumes streak freeze protections on missed days, and calculates quadratic XP growth.
observed_fact: Direct Kotlin implementation: recordStudySession() computes local calendar delta days, increments streak on consecutive days (delta=1), consumes streak_freeze on missed day (delta=2), and computes level L = floor(sqrt(XP/100)) + 1.
